title: 2013 White House rumours of 'confirmation, not disclosure'

tellings.quote: You get to Vallée's most recent journals, he documents early in 2013 rumors coming out of the White House. And these rumors are essentially saying they're planning to do something called confirmation, not disclosure.

plain: Early in 2013, rumours came out of the White House that officials were planning something called 'confirmation, not disclosure', meaning they would confirm that something real is going on without a full public announcement of what the government knows. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this, citing the most recent published journals of the longtime UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, where he says the rumours are recorded.
